final: SELECT cr.raceId, c.country, SUM(CASE WHEN cr.points IS NOT NULL THEN cr.points ELSE 0 END) as total_points, COUNT(*) as num_entries, COUNT(*) - (SELECT AVG(entry_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as entry_count FROM constructorResults GROUP BY raceId)) as difference_from_avg FROM constructorResults cr JOIN races r ON cr.raceId = r.raceId JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId GROUP BY cr.raceId HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT AVG(entry_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as entry_count FROM constructorResults GROUP BY raceId)) ORDER BY difference_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10
